data: Dans les années 50 et 60, en pleine campagne américaine, au pied des Catskills, une petite maison en bois et sa grange ont abrité le premier réseau clandestin de travestis. Diane et Kate ont aujourd'hui 80 ans. À l'époque, elles étaient de sexe masculin et faisaient partie de cette organisation secrète. Aujourd'hui, elles relatent ce chapitre oublié mais essentiel des débuts de la trans-identité, une histoire pleine de bruit et de fureur, riche de personnages extraordinaires, dont la célèbre Susanna, qui a eu le courage de créer ce refuge qui est devenu la Casa Susanna. (In the 50s and 60s, deep in the American countryside, at the foot of the Catskills, a small wooden house with a barn behind was home to the first clandestine network of cross-dressers. Diane and Kate are now 80 years old. At the time, they were men and part of this secret organization. Today, they relate this forgotten but essential chapter of the early days of trans-identity. It is a story full of noise and fury, rich in extraordinary characters, including the famous Susanna, who had the courage to create this refuge that came to be known as Casa Susanna.)

In the 50s and 60s, deep in the American countryside, at the foot of the Catskills, a small wooden house with a barn behind was home to the first clandestine network of cross-dressers. Diane and Kate are now 80 years old. At the time, they were men and part of this secret organization. Today, they relate this forgotten but essential chapter of the early days of trans-identity.
